name: PPC Production Actual Summary
query:
SELECT
  pa.name AS `Actual:Link/PPC Production Actual:160`,
  pa.posting_date AS `Date:Date:100`,
  pa.shift AS `Shift:Data:100`,
  pa.workstation AS `Workstation:Link/Workstation:160`,
  pa.supervisor AS `Supervisor:Link/User:160`,
  pi.source_job_card AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  pi.stage AS `Stage:Data:140`,
  pi.operator AS `Operator:Data:140`,
  pi.good_quantity AS `Good:Float:100`,
  pi.good_uom AS `UOM:Data:80`,
  pi.rejected_quantity AS `Rejected:Float:90`,
  pi.waste_quantity AS `Waste:Float:90`,
  pi.downtime_minutes AS `Downtime (min):Int:110`,
  pi.qc_status AS `QC:Data:90`
FROM `tabPPC Production Actual` pa
INNER JOIN `tabPPC Production Actual Item` pi ON pi.parent = pa.name
WHERE pa.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY pa.posting_date DESC, pa.workstation ASC
